new_content.name: Pumpkin Carving Station
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft from an iron ingot, shears, a crafting table and some planks.
new_content.notes: Dyes (up to 3 dyes) and carves (up to 4 stencils) pumpkins.

new_content.name: Carving Stencils
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft a Blank Stencil from paper and a pumpkin seed, then combine with a matching item. Heart, Jigsaw, Spawner and Structure Block stencils are rare loot only (village houses, strongholds, woodland mansions, dungeons, ancient cities, end cities).

new_content.name: Lit and candle-lit decorated pumpkins
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft a decorated pumpkin with a torch; or sneak and use up to four candles on it.
new_content.notes: Torch light 15, soul 10, copper 14, redstone 7; candles add 3/6/9/12. Shear to take contents back.

mechanics.title: Wearable pumpkins
mechanics.description: Decorated pumpkins (not lit) can be worn as a helmet; endermen are not angered, carved openings let you see out, and an uncarved face blocks view. A config option lowers the obstruction.

vanilla_changes.change: A torch on a carved pumpkin makes a jack o'lantern; shears on a jack o'lantern take the torch back.

commands_and_keybinds: Turn Worn Pumpkin: keybind is UNBOUND by default; bind it in Options > Controls.
getting_started: Craft a Pumpkin Carving Station, then dye and carve a pumpkin with stencils.
editor_notes: Facts come from the mod README, not the jar or in-game testing. Dispensers can light, unlight and shear pumpkins. Advancements exist (two secret).
name: All Hallows Steve
summary: Halloween-themed pumpkin dyeing, carving with reusable stencils, lit and candle-lit pumpkins, and wearable decorated pumpkins. Made by the pack author.
